evals.name: estimatable slice adds software requirements and checklist
evals.prompt: Refine only CHG-001, the saved-filter implementation slice associated with FEAT-42. The slice should let a reviewer create and reuse a named filter for changes requiring attention. Keep rationale, observable outcome, and out-of-scope explicit. Use the existing approved product/component requirements and create testable level=software requirements with BDD example prose. The scope and acceptance examples are estimatable; make CHG-001 refined and then create its temporary task checklist. Do not write to any ticket or touch another change.
evals.expected_output: Refines only CHG-001, preserves featureTicketId=FEAT-42, addresses existing approved product/component requirements, creates software requirements that refines their applicable parent requirement, and creates tasks only after marking the estimatable slice refined.

expectations.text: Change refinement writes only its own change and software requirements.
A new detailed behavior requirement is software-level.
New change requirements retain the shared feature ticket.
An estimatable refined slice receives its temporary checklist.

evals.name: not-estimatable slice gets no checklist
evals.prompt: Refine CHG-001 only. The featureTicketId is FEAT-42; use the already approved product and component requirements. The current change description is vague: 'Make filters better.' Help me define the scope and software-level requirements, but an integration decision remains open and the slice is not yet estimatable. Do not mark the change refined, create a task checklist, or call any tracker.
evals.expected_output: Records only the agreed draft refinement; CHG-001 remains proposed, no temporary checklist exists, and the unresolved integration decision is explicit.

expectations.text: No temporary checklist is created before estimatable readiness.
